## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates your ability to design extensible systems using advanced pattern composition: runtime extension of routing behavior through Strategy + Registry patterns, while ensuring testability and safety in production gateway environments.

## Key Concepts

- Strategy pattern for pluggable algorithms
- Registry and Factory for dynamic instantiation
- Composite routing with per-endpoint configuration
- Observability and comprehensive fault tolerance testing

## Code Example

```javascript
// Implementation sketch
class LoadBalancer { next(targets) {} }
class CircuitBreaker { allowRequest() { ... } }
class Registry { register(name, factory) ... get(name) ... }
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How to version strategies for backward compatibility?
- What observability metrics should each strategy expose?
- How would you handle strategy hot-reloading in production?

## Why This Is Asked

To evaluate ability to extend behavior via composition without touching core, simulating production plugin ecosystems.

- Strategy pattern
- Plugin registry
- Runtime loading
- Safety sandboxing
- Contract tests

```javascript
// Minimal interfaces
interface AllocationStrategy {
  allocate(userId: string, variants: string[]): string;
}
class UniformStrategy implements AllocationStrategy { allocate(u,v){ /* simple round-robin/hash */ return v[0]; } }
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you handle versioning of strategies?
- How would you audit/roll back a faulty strategy?
